subject: CAIQ control coverage heatmap & evidence transfer plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: LumenHealth Security <security@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control coverage heatmap & evidence transfer plan

Hi Ana and team,

Thanks again for sharing the CAIQ request set. We completed our initial crosswalk and attached a coverage "heatmap" that maps each CSA control family to our current artifacts and live telemetry availability. High-level notes: 

- Coverage: ~83% of subcontrols are covered by documentation + runtime proof. The remaining ~17% are either policy-only or need live extracts (telemetry/logs, key rotation records).
- Ownership: we've proposed new owners for 12 ambiguous subcontrols (column "proposed_owner" in the heatmap).
- Evidence transfer: to avoid repeated attachments, we'd like to stage artifacts in a secure SFTP folder and give your team read-only links. We included a checklist with expected filenames and minimal redaction guidance.

Action items I propose this week:
1) You confirm which subcontrols you want live proof for vs. artifact proof (timeline below).
2) We provision SFTP + temporary creds for LumenHealth and AuditsRUs (48h expiry per parcel).
3) Owners named in the heatmap prepare artifacts listed in the checklist; David will validate runtime logs.

Proposed timeline: confirmation by Tue 2027-05-24, evidence parcels delivered Wed–Thu 2027-05-25–26, quick smoke review Fri 2027-05-27.

Attachments: CAIQ-Coverage-heatmap-v1.xlsx, Evidence-Transfer-Checklist.pdf (stub).

If that timeline works, I'll kick off provisioning today.

Thanks,
Priyom
Sr. Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ana Ruiz <security@lumenhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditsRUs <auditor@auditsrus.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:17:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control coverage heatmap & evidence transfer plan

Priyom,

Appreciate the heatmap — looks thorough. A couple of clarifying points before we confirm: 

1) For subcontrols that request "key rotation attestations", do you have KMS key rotation logs that include rotation timestamps and operator identity? We need rotation events for the last 12 months.
2) For runtime logs: we only need a representative 24-hour window per region (us-east-1). Can those be sanitized to remove customer PII?
3) Regarding ownership reassignments: we'll accept proposed owners but need an escalation path if owner is unresponsive for >3 business days.

If you can confirm items 1–2 and the SFTP approach, we'll confirm the timeline by Tues. Also please include any high-level notes on multi-tenant isolation (we saw your note but want a short blurb for the CAIQ narrative).

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Information Security
LumenHealth

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <security@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, AuditsRUs <auditor@auditsrus.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control coverage heatmap & evidence transfer plan

Ana — quick answers: 

1) KMS rotation: yes. We can export rotation events from our KMS audit trail (Cloud KMS + HSM attestation) for the last 12 months. The file will list key id, rotation timestamp, rotation trigger type (scheduled/manual), and service account identity. We'll redact service account emails to role names per your guidance.

2) Runtime logs: we will provide a 24h sample from us-east-1 and strip PII at source using our logmasker pipeline. David will attach the masking manifest so you can verify what was removed.

3) Owner escalation: agreed. Proposed owners will be assigned a secondary owner and an escalation contact (we added an "escalation_contact" column in the heatmap). If owners do not respond within 3 business days, Priyom (me) will escalate to the relevant manager.

Multitenancy blurb (short): Redwood enforces tenant separation at the routing layer and the serving runtime using per-tenant namespaces, customer-specific key wrapping, and strict KV cache segmentation. We've included the architecture diagram reference in the heatmap notes.

I'll start provisioning SFTP credentials today and loop David to coordinate the log extraction.

— Priyom

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <security@lumenhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, AuditsRUs <auditor@auditsrus.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control coverage heatmap & evidence transfer plan

Ana — I'm David, infra owner for runtime telemetry. Quick notes on the log bundle and masking: 

- Contents: request-trace.log (tokenized request ids), scheduling.log, gpu-runtime-stats.json (summarized), auth-events.log (redacted), and a masking-manifest.json that lists regex rules applied.
- We will provide rotation artifacts for KMS as CSV and a signed HSM attestation PDF. KMS exports will include local key aliases (no long ARNs) and operator-role names instead of full IAM principals.
- Upload plan: we'll stage evidence into SFTP:/incoming/lumenhealth/caiq_parcels/ and create one parcel per control family (compute, key_mgmt, data_flow, telemetry). Each parcel will have a parcel_manifest.txt with checksums. Parcels expire in 72 hours.

Attachment stubs: runtime-log-sample.tar.gz (sample parcel), Evidence-Transfer-Checklist.pdf.

If the auditor needs additional fields in the masking manifest, please let us know and we'll regenerate the sample.

Thanks,
David Kim
Principal Infra Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Ana Ruiz <security@lumenhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, AuditsRUs <auditor@auditsrus.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 16:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control coverage heatmap & evidence transfer plan

Team — this is great, thanks for the clarity. We accept the SFTP parcel approach and the proposed masking rules. A couple of final asks before you upload: 

- Please include a short README in each parcel that states which heatmap row(s) the artifacts support (control id(s) and brief description).
- For the key rotation CSV, please include a column for "rotation_method" (auto/manual) and a boolean "compliance_window_met" that indicates whether rotation interval met our required cadence.

We'll schedule a 30-minute walkthrough Thurs 2027-05-26 10:00 AM ET to spot-check the parcels and close outstanding questions. Auditor (cc) will confirm their availability.

I'll mark the timeline confirmed. See you Thursday.

Regards,
Ana
